definitions.explanation: Very heavy rainfall, often causing flooding or other damage.

examples.japanese: {豪雨|ごうう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{氾濫|はんらん}した→氾濫：09256_hanran⟧。
examples.english: The river flooded due to the heavy rain.

examples.japanese: {豪雨|ごうう}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}された→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧。
examples.english: A heavy rain warning was issued.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記録的|きろくてき}→記録的：28788_kirokuteki⟧な{豪雨|ごうう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われた→見舞われる：27351_mimawareru⟧。
examples.english: We were hit by record-breaking heavy rain.

notes:
{豪雨|ごうう} refers to very heavy rainfall, often causing flooding or damage. More intense than ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧.

FORMS:
⟦{豪|ごう}→豪：noentry⟧ (great, intense) + ⟦{雨|う}→雨：00583_ame⟧ (rain)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {豪雨|ごうう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞われる：27351_mimawareru⟧: to be hit by heavy rain
- {豪雨|ごうう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{浸水|しんすい}→浸水：14945_shinsui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be flooded by heavy rain

COMPOUNDS:
- {豪雨|ごうう}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧: heavy rain warning
- ⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}→集中：03212_shuuchuu⟧{豪雨|ごうう}: localized torrential rain
- {豪雨|ごうう}⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧: heavy rain disaster
- ⟦{記録的|きろくてき}→記録的：28788_kirokuteki⟧{豪雨|ごうう}: record-breaking heavy rain

RAIN INTENSITY SCALE:
- ⟦{小雨|こさめ}→小雨：05861_kosame⟧: light rain
- ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧: rain
- ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧: heavy rain
- {豪雨|ごうう}: torrential rain

Note: Common in news reports about weather disasters.
